description.value: Rivers Edge Cabins offers two private riverfront cabins on the Nahatlatch River near Boston Bar, BC, situated 1 km from Nahatlatch Provincial Park with access to hiking, fishing, rafting, and wildlife viewing. The property reopened after a wildfire and now also offers one RV/camping spot, with eco-friendly shared washroom facilities including flush toilets, on-demand hot water, and solar-powered lighting. It is a deliberately quiet, off-the-grid-style retreat well-positioned for cyclists exploring the Fraser Canyon corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides the primary evidence. The phone number 604-206-9882 and mailing address (Box 24, Boston Bar, BC V0K 1C0) are confirmed across multiple subpages. The site notes seasonal operation (April 1 to Thanksgiving) and mentions a post-wildfire rebuild, but the business is clearly open and welcoming guests. No mention of bike-specific amenities anywhere on the site; the washrooms page confirms showers but no bike wash or storage is referenced.
concerns: OSM record has no address; mailing address (Box 24, Boston Bar, BC V0K 1C0) taken from website contact page.
Seasonal operation only: closed after Thanksgiving weekend until April 1 each year.
Property recently rebuilt after a wildfire; some amenities may still be limited as rebuilding continues.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating, publicly bookable accommodation on the Nahatlatch River near Boston Bar; open seasonally April 1 to Thanksgiving with clear contact details and active web presence.
enrichment_extras.notes: The site describes the experience as 'truly unplugged' — this appears to be used metaphorically, but Wi-Fi availability is unconfirmed. Worth asking the host directly at booking.

wow_evidence: two private riverfront cabins on the Nahatlatch River near Boston Bar

price.signal: two rustic riverfront cabins near Boston Bar; private cabins rarely under $80 even when basic; ~$120-150
